title: Prepare the Eidolon Chamber
description: Rites, souls, occult binding, and necromantic work require a room prepared for deliberate practice rather than incidental unpleasantness. Establish Eidolon's first working apparatus in the Tower. This makes the facility usable; sacred and wicked paths, sacrifices, soul work, and later rites remain part of Eidolon's dedicated progression and are not swallowed by Tower Restoration.
description_completed: The Dark Tower's Eidolon facility is operational. Deeper ritual and occult progression remains outside Tower Restoration.

prerequisites.name: Establish the first foundation of the reign
